title: Integrability of a smooth function of a random variable
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $Z:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^{m+1}(\mu)$. Let $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $(m+1)$-times continuously differentiable, and suppose there is a real number $C$ such that $|\psi^{(m+1)}(t)|\le C$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$. Then $\omega\mapsto\psi(Z(\omega))$ is integrable under $\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: a real bound $C$ on the absolute value of the $(m+1)$st derivative
